subject.title: fix(clickclack): deliver media and configurable model replies [AI-assisted]

question: Should ClickClack model mode gain a public per-account `maxTokens` setting and change existing accounts from a 96-token limit to a 512-token default?
rationale: The repository deliberately keeps config surfaces small, and source inspection cannot determine the intended ClickClack cost, latency, and reply-length policy or whether the provider/model default should own this limit.

options.title: Split and harden
options.body: Land retry-safe media delivery and empty-result diagnostics, while moving the token-budget config/default change to separately sponsored work with live model proof.

options.title: Keep the combined change
options.body: Approve the 512-token default and public setting, then require retry-safety repair plus fresh-install, upgrade, cost/latency, and live five-account reply proof before merge.

options.title: Use an internal policy
options.body: Remove the public setting and select an owner-approved fixed or provider-derived model-reply budget with focused behavioral documentation and proof.

recommendation.title: Split and harden
recommendation.body: Land retry-safe media delivery and empty-result diagnostics, while moving the token-budget config/default change to separately sponsored work with live model proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current ClickClack model-reply implementation and its fixed token policy appear to originate from Bek's feature work.
